messages:
Ravi Kumar: Noticing intermittent rack-level egress saturation in apac-south during node reprovisioning window 02:03-02:07 UTC. Per-tenant tails show one tenant spiking ~4.2x.
Elena Park: Any idea which tenant?
Ravi Kumar: tenant=magellan-ml. Query: `topk(5, sum(rate(egress_bytes_total{rack=\"rack-22\"}[1m])) by (tenant))`
Ravi Kumar: Logs show repeated slot handoffs + warm-slot prefetch bursts. Sample:
```
2026-03-21T02:03:11Z slot_handoff tenant=magellan-ml from_node=n1 to_node=n5 reason=drain
2026-03-21T02:03:11Z prefetch_start tenant=magellan-ml slot=warm-17 bytes_expected=1048576
2026-03-21T02:03:12Z prefetch_write tenant=magellan-ml bytes=65536
2026-03-21T02:03:12Z prefetch_write tenant=magellan-ml bytes=65536
```
Samir Dutta: Warm-prefetch size looks huge (1MiB) and many handoffs coincide with maintenance. Could be external client SDK aggressively preloading.
Elena Park: Is this exclusively apac-south rack-22 or wider?
Ravi Kumar: Mostly rack-22 and sibling rack-23 on the same Top-of-Rack switch. Upstream link hit 92% for 30s.
Nadia Lopez: Ops alert: created I-2026-331-apac-egress-hotspot (owner: Ravi Kumar).
Samir Dutta: Short-term: throttle prefetch writes by rate limiter per-tenant at the runtime side; add a per-slot prefetch token bucket. Medium-term: reduce default prefetch target size for warm slots for large-model tenants.
Elena Park: Could we instead stagger warm-slot assignments during rolling drains (spread 1s gaps)? That would avoid synchronized refills.
Ravi Kumar: Good idea. Two prongs: 1) immediate config override to limit prefetch KBps to 1500 for magellan-ml, 2) runtime patch to jitter warm-slot assign by 200-800ms in apac region.
Samir Dutta: Also add handshake retry exponential backoff clamp so we don't amplify with retries.
Elena Park: I'll prepare stencil override for magellan-ml and push a probe to canary rack-22.
Ravi Kumar: CI-bot: run egress-smoke test with 200 concurrent handoffs to validate.
ci-bot: egress-smoke test queued on canary-rack-22.
Nadia Lopez: Rollout notes: set alarm for rack egress >85% for 15s and per-tenant >3x baseline.
Samir Dutta: After canary, we should lower the default warm_prefetch_target for tenants above 2TB/month to 512KB. Add to infra policy.
Ravi Kumar: Patch applied to stencil at 02:18 UTC, canary run in progress.
Elena Park: Dashboard shows canary peak reduced ~72%, rack-level link dropped to 58% util.
Ravi Kumar: Nice. Filing follow-up: ENG-9982 reduce-prefetch-defaults-and-jitter, assign Samir.
Samir Dutta: I'll take it. Also reaching out to solutions eng to notify magellan-ml to consider client backoff tuning.
Elena Park: Closing action: once ENG-9982 merged we'll schedule a global rollout and update runbooks.
